verdict.rationale: Snyk exposes an MCP server and CLI that AI coding agents can drive (documented setup, live handshake returning tool/prompt capabilities, slash-commands like /snyk-fix), which is real agentic-facing tooling, but there is no evidence of a documented conventional public REST/OpenAPI surface — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404'd, and CLI scans require prior account authentication rather than being a fully open API.
